scope: Bounded live webpage coding edit, native approval, process execution, and rendered-page verification in TestProj

client.surface: xMind webpage in Codex in-app browser
client.credential: Existing local provider profile; secret omitted

run.prompt_constraint: One focused hero refinement, styles only, preserve Vue template and script, run one frontend build, stop after success

file_operation.approval: Reviewed and allowed in the webpage UI
file_operation.scope: CSS only: hero heading scale, line height, width, and responsive text spacing

rendered_page.title: Model Zoo · model registry catalog
rendered_page.rendered_content: Hero, catalog snapshot, filters, and model cards rendered after the approved edit and build

limits: This verifies one bounded webpage coding task, not broad coding reliability or full project redesign.
TestProj is not a Git repository, so a tracked source diff was unavailable.
The large HomeView.vue read contributed to a 30,503-token edit-proposal request; context efficiency remains an optimization target.
